getting_there.text: Vehicle entrance Avenue 2; limited parking LevelsB1/B2. Exit promptly after Mass; double-parking disallowed but may block vehicles during Mass. Alternatives HDB Blocks 271/269 and Bukit Batok Nature Park opposite. Nearest MRT Bukit Batok NS2 / Beauty World DT5.

sacraments.text: In English and Mandarin. Registration for 2026/27 is closed; contact the parish about the next intake. Enquiries welcome, with no pressure. Sponsors and service-team volunteers can also enquire.

Infant/child portal https://baptism.stmary.sg/ for schedules, preparation and registration. At least one Catholic parent/guardian; max 2 godparents of different genders, practising Catholics over 16. Birth certificate, church wedding/ROM certificates, godparent baptism/confirmation certificates, minor consent form. Parents/godparents compulsory in-person preparation Tuesday 19:30 at Gubbio LevelB2, pre-scheduled. First-come booking; minimum 5 children for service. Register online and email documents.

Request appointment online or through reception for home/hospital Communion, reconciliation, anointing or pastoral counselling. Served institutions include St Luke’s, Ren Ci, Ng Teng Fong General, Jurong Community, All Saints Home, United Medicare, Bukit Batok Home and Bukit Batok Care Home.
